headers = ["wtype_id", "name", "status", "orgId", "careType", "specialtyId", "contextId"]

def convert_value(v):
    v = str(v).strip().strip('"').strip()
    if re.fullmatch(r"\d+", v):
        return int(v)
    return v

def extract_scalar(filter_text, key):
    m = re.search(rf'\("{re.escape(key)}"\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"\)', filter_text)
    return m.group(1) if m else None

def extract_list(filter_text, key):
    m = re.search(rf'\("{re.escape(key)}"\s+IN\s+LIST\s+([^)]+)\)', filter_text)
    if not m:

    return vals if vals else [None]

    wtype_id = ws_in.cell(r, col_map["wtype_id"]).value
    name = ws_in.cell(r, col_map["name"]).value

    filter_text = ws_in.cell(r, col_map["filter"]).value or ""

    org_id = extract_scalar(filter_text, "orgId")

    context_ids = extract_list(filter_text, "contextId")

# Fill only rows A2:G10, matching the permitted range

    for col_idx, value in enumerate(row_values, start=1):
